name: PT Sebukit Inter Nusa
summary: PT Sebukit Inter Nusa is an oil palm company in West Kalimantan. Nusantara Atlas satellite data, as reported by The Jakarta Post, show 526 ha burned inside its concession between January and July 2026. The article does not name its owner and we could not find one in the sources we read. This profile does not establish who lit any fire.

burnedHa.method: Burned area inside the concession for January to July 2026, as measured by Nusantara Atlas and reported by The Jakarta Post (published 11 September 2026). We did not measure it ourselves and have not seen the underlying Nusantara Atlas dataset. The article lists the company ninth among the ten concessions with the largest burned area.

evidence.summary: Nusantara Atlas satellite data, as reported by The Jakarta Post, show 526 ha burned inside the concession between January and July 2026. This is satellite detection of burned area. It does not show how the fires began.

concessions.summary: The Jakarta Post reports that the company did not respond to its requests for comment. We searched English and Indonesian news for a statement about the 2026 fires and found none. We found no source naming the company's owner, so no parent is stated.

financials.reason: No financial statements for this company were found in public filings. The company is not listed, and the sources read do not identify a listed parent whose filings could be used (ADR-0005).
